allowed_angles: Gentle story about noticing small changes before unsteadiness.
General education on standing slowly, safer walking paths, stable footwear, hydration awareness, and symptom logging.
Encouraging consultation when dizziness repeats or appears with concerning symptoms.
forbidden_angles: Diagnosing the character or viewer with a specific vestibular, neurological, or cardiovascular disease.
Claiming the story tips prevent all falls or cure dizziness.
Telling viewers to change medication or water restriction without clinician guidance.
Showing dramatic collapse, panic, emergency scenes, or fear-based thumbnail imagery.
mandatory_softeners: Use 'ことがあります', 'かもしれません', and '相談してみましょう' rather than certainty language.
Frame changes as small clues and safer habits, not proof of disease.
Include urgent/early consultation cues for repeated dizziness or red-flag symptoms.
visual_restrictions: No falling, fainting, dramatic wobble, panic, hospital emergency imagery, or red warning graphics.
Maintain kamishibai paper theater / gouache watercolor style with warm paper texture.
No lip sync, mouth-open acting, direct speech pose, generated audio, or dialogue balloons.
Avoid generated readable text except approved short thumbnail text.
disclosure_notes: This is general senior-wellness education delivered as a fictional composite story. It is not diagnosis or individualized medical advice.
warnings_for_outline: Keep one-story structure. Do not turn into a numbered listicle. Include consultation section near the end.
warnings_for_script: Keep narration gentle, non-commanding, and story-first. Avoid disease labels unless referring generally to clinician evaluation.
warnings_for_prompt_builders: Motion prompts must be micro-motion only and silent. No speech, no lip movement, no new visible text.
warnings_for_publication_assets: Title and thumbnail must avoid fear theater. Use curiosity around 'small sign' rather than warning or diagnosis.
